body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md (one ADK agent runs the tool loop and the UI shows which tool ran; Gemini writes the explanation from optimizer JSON only; the README must answer Why isn’t rice discounted?). Do not edit that file or specs/001-product-vision/spec.md. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets. Rails freeze fixtures/**, the optimizer, receipts, explain, gemini, every existing test file, the scripts, the Dockerfile, docs/deploy.md, and pyproject.toml.

1. No model configured is a clean state, not a crash. NullModelClient raises a typed ModelNotConfigured error from extract and explain. POST /v1/receipts returns 503 with detail receipt model not configured and logs no traceback. POST /v1/explain returns 200 with the engine sentence Legal saving: <discount> LKR. and source engine. When a model answers, source is model.

2. Per-line reasons. /v1/plans plan summaries include lines with sku_id, qty, status (eligible, excluded, unpriced) and shelf_lkr from the optimizer. Below the plans, the guest page shows a line check for the store that has an offer that day: item name, category, shelf amount, and a reason built only from the fixtures. Examples: a staple line at Keells on Saturday says this offer excludes staple items; an eligible fresh line says it is in the offer categories; a store without an offer says no card offer applies. This answers Why isn’t rice discounted? on the page without a model.

3. Explain this plan. A new form control named exactly Explain this plan prices the basket like a plan request and then explains the winning plan.
- When a model is configured (GEMINI_MODEL plus GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, or GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true) or app.state.agent_runner is set, the page runs the ADK root_agent through an InMemoryRunner with the confirmed basket, day, and usual store. The page lists the tool names from the agent's actual function-call events, in order, as Agent tools called: ... and shows the agent text after the explain number filter: any token with a number absent from the winning plan JSON is dropped, and the Legal saving sentence is appended when the discount digits are missing. The agent call has a 60 second timeout. On timeout or error the page shows the engine explanation and says the agent call failed.
- Without a model, the page shows the engine explanation labeled Model not configured.
src/savvycart/agent.py gains build_agent(model) and async ask_agent(question, lines, weekday, date, usual_store, agent=None) returning text and tools. root_agent stays the single agent, built with build_agent(GEMINI_MODEL).

4. README.md describes the Explain this plan step and the line check, and no longer says the page lacks an explanation. python scripts/check_judge_readme.py still passes.

tests/test_agent_page.py uses fakes only: a fake agent_runner on app.state for the page, and a scripted BaseLlm subclass that drives the real ADK InMemoryRunner through load_catalog, load_offers, and run_optimizer calls.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Extract without a model returns 503. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_page.py::test_extract_without_model_is_503 -q
2. The line check explains why rice is not discounted. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_page.py::test_line_check_explains_rice -q
3. Explain this plan shows the agent's tool calls and filtered text. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_page.py::test_explain_button_shows_agent_tools_and_filters_numbers -q
4. Without a model the page shows the engine explanation. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_page.py::test_explain_button_without_model_uses_engine -q
5. The real ADK runner calls the tools with a scripted model. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_agent_page.py::test_ask_agent_runs_adk_tool_loop -q
6. The README still passes its checker. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: Explain plans through the ADK agent and fail cleanly without a model
